purpose: Support a direct-mail response experiment. Suggestions are hypotheses, not evidence about a recipient or permission to send.

playbooks.title: Stock and supplier timing
playbooks.guidance: Consider an inventory segment when the objective concerns stock purchases or supplier payment timing. Frame the situation as a possibility, not a known need.

playbooks.title: Project and client payment timing
playbooks.guidance: Consider a contractor segment when the objective concerns project expenses or client payment timing. Frame the situation as a possibility, not a known need.

experiment: Compare planning-ahead and payment-timing framing with a holdout. The outcome is response, not demonstrated incremental value.
